summary: The character-creation spell picker colours each spell's realm name by the spell's school index via a 6-word table at wroot.exe file offset 0xff84: [4, 2, 3, 6, 7, 5]. The on-screen attr is nibble<<4 (wfont0 highlight path, low-nibble 0). FIRE=0x40, WATER=0x20, AIR=0x30, EARTH=0x60, MENTAL=0x70, MAGIC=0x50. All six were pixel-verified on screen by navigating the picker's 3x2 school grid (left/right switches column, up/down moves within column). NOTE: school 5's display name is MAGIC (msg.dbs 0x0f73), not DIVINE; the 6 realm names are msg.dbs 0x0f6e..0x0f73 = FIRE/WATER/AIR/EARTH/MENTAL/MAGIC.

findings.claim: school->colour-nibble table is 6 words at wroot.exe file 0xff84 = [4,2,3,6,7,5], indexed by spell school 0..5 (Fire,Water,Air,Earth,Mental,Divine). Realm attr = nibble<<4.

evidence.context: Sits in a block of small word-tables (preceding word at 0xff82 = 0x0005; following words at 0xff90 = 06 06 03 07 ...). Exactly 6 entries, matching the 6 spell schools.

findings.claim: Front half of the table (Fire/Water/Air) is behaviourally verified: pixel-picked from live DOSBox-X engine framebuffers of the creation spell picker (Mage, M-Elf), each maps to the table-predicted palette index exactly.

evidence.method: Loaded the parked spell-picker save (game_state 0x10), scrolled the Mage's 3-spell pool, screenshotted each. Pixel-picked the realm-label text colour in the spellOuter r12 region (screen x248-300, y128-136) and matched against WIZ6_MAIN palette (AC-chained-through-DAC RGB).
results: ENERGY BLAST -> FIRE  -> palette idx 4 (255,85,85 bright red)    -> attr 0x40  (table nibble 4) MATCH
CHILLING TOUCH/TERROR -> WATER -> palette idx 2 (85,85,255 bright blue) -> attr 0x20 (table nibble 2) MATCH
(unnamed) -> AIR -> palette idx 3 (255,85,255 bright magenta) -> attr 0x30 (table nibble 3) MATCH
evidence.captures: tools/dosbox/capture/wroot_057.png (FIRE), wroot_060.png (WATER), wroot_058.png (AIR) — disposable scratch, not committed

findings.claim: All six realm colours are pixel-verified on screen. The picker is a SCHOOL GRID of all six schools (the school-mana icons on the character sheet); the cursor index 0..5 == school index. Per the binary (idiv 3 at wpcmk 0x2459, see spell-picker-eligibility.json), the grid is 3 columns x 2 rows: row0 = FIRE(0)/WATER(1)/AIR(2), row1 = EARTH(3)/MENTAL(4)/MAGIC(5). LEFT/RIGHT step +/-3 (between the two rows); UP/DOWN step +/-1 within a row (mod-3 clamped). My earlier 'clamp at AIR' was just the end of the top row's within-row movement — I had never pressed RIGHT (which jumps +3 to EARTH). All six schools are navigable even when the class has no selectable spell there (the spell name renders blank).

evidence.method: Drove a Mage to the picker, then navigated the school grid: from FIRE, RIGHT -> EARTH (green, ARMOR SHIELD), DOWN -> MENTAL (cyan, SLEEP), DOWN -> MAGIC (yellow, blank). Pixel-picked each realm label from the engine framebuffer.
results: school 3 EARTH  -> palette idx 6 (85,255,85 bright green)  -> attr 0x60  (table nibble 6) MATCH
school 4 MENTAL -> palette idx 7 (85,255,255 bright cyan)  -> attr 0x70  (table nibble 7) MATCH
school 5 MAGIC  -> palette idx 5 (255,255,85 bright yellow)-> attr 0x50  (table nibble 5) MATCH
evidence.implication: The full table [4,2,3,6,7,5] is now behaviourally verified 6/6. The realm NAME for school 5 is MAGIC (msg.dbs 0x0f73), not DIVINE.
